explanation: The mismatch (m_axis_tvalid=1 when expected 0) indicates spurious output of data from an incomplete or invalid frame. The FRAME_FIFO logic must only commit frames when s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tlast. Candidates 011, 021, 023, 025, 026, 028, 030, 031 add s_axis_tvalid/last and full_cur guards around write/depth conditions, directly preventing acceptance of partial frames that would otherwise be dequeued. Reset and USER_ENABLE edits are less relevant to the frame-commit policy.
